title: The Yardmaster's Key
pitch: The old yardmaster held the key to Victor's stash. He's dead. His widow has it, and strangers have been asking.

clue_a.label: The boxcar
lines: Fresh gouges round the padlock on the platform locker by the boxcar. Somebody's tried it without a key.

clue_b.label: The van
lines: A packed suitcase hidden in the burned-out van, a train ticket on top. She's leaving town tomorrow.
